context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

Our ECS EC2 Windows daemon collector is on an older CDOT build and cannot reach the Docker engine, but we still need the host-related resource attributes for Infra Explorer. What should we do?

checklist.name: windows-ecsattributes-fallback
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: (?i)(Windows|Docker|ecsattributes|task metadata|Infra Explorer)

checklist.name: upgrade-v0-5-11-or-newer
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: (?i)(v0[.]5[.]11|0[.]5[.]11|upgrade|newer|current CDOT)

checklist.name: explains-fallback-to-ecs-task-metadata
checklist.description: Explains that `ecsattributesprocessor` falls back to ECS task metadata when Docker is unavailable on Windows, so host-related resource attributes can still populate for Infra Explorer. Mentions that older builds need an upgrade rather than claiming the Windows path cannot work without Docker.

checklist.name: no-claims-windows-needs-docker
checklist.description: A response that says Windows ECS must have Docker, that host metadata cannot be recovered on Windows, or that the user should just remove the ECS attributes processor is a FAIL.
